provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.math.theorem.selection against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:select, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_declaration, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:theorem_source, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:chapter_roles, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_theorems_show_the_exact_named_statement_and_proof, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_theorems_select_literal_qualified_names, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_theorems_reject_wrong_kinds_and_malformed_directives, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:markdown_proof_blocks_reject_invalid_targets_and_all_nested_proof_kinds, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::selects_complete_named_theorems_without_comment_or_string_decoys, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::rejects_wrong_kind_ambiguous_and_incomplete_theorem_selections. Theorem/lemma selection requires a named theorem with := body; the extractor rejects wrong kinds, duplicate/unsupported declarations and indented sibling commands. Rendering retains the exact selected statement/proof and forbids nested proof/definition/example blocks. Tests cover literal qualified names, comments/string decoys, complete proof output and every nested block-kind combination. Lean proof correctness remains a separate check. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
